text: frank: Quick design review: SLO slider guardrails and min/max copy. Updated frames: https://figma.com/file/zz. Need quick takes on hard vs soft guardrails, burst label, and aria text. nina: My vote: label explicitly "Minimum GPUs" / "Maximum GPUs". Users get confused by shorthand. Add tiny "Recommended: X" pill next to steppers. lee: For guardrails: use soft (yellow) for cost guidance and hard (red) for SLA breaches. Copy proposal for hard: "Blocked: this setting would violate SLA floors. Contact ops to change reserved capacity." Soft copy: "Warning: may increase cost. Override allowed." marco: Burst naming: "Burst capacity" is clear. Add help text: "Temporary extra GPUs to handle short spikes (configurable duration)." a11y-bot: Accessibility notes: 1) aria-labels for steppers e.g. "Increase minimum GPUs" 2) aria-describedby to link help text 3) aria-live region for SLO slider updates. Example: Minimum GPUs to keep warm for latency SLOs. frank: UX flow: if recommendation applied, show toast "Settings updated 0s Undo" and emit event capacity.recommendation.applied{pool,reason}. For large/reserved changes show modal with explicit confirm. nina: Also prevent min > burst and surface that inline with an inline error: "Minimum cannot exceed burst capacity." lee: SLO slider tooltip copy: short: "SLO: lower latency = higher cost" + link to docs. Keep tooltips concise. marco: I'll update mocks with recommended pill and two guardrail states. Will add keyboard notes for steppers and slider. frank: Agreed. Action items: Marco - mocks; Lee - copy variants; Nina - telemetry events; Josh (infra) - ensure API accepts suggestion.apply with rollback window. Closing the thread, ping me for urgent changes. :white_check_mark:
